what: a circle of radius 5 on XY swept with orientation parallel along a path rising 20 mm while leaning 20 mm in x (the profile does not turn: a sheared cylinder)
method: with the profile keeping its attitude the body is an oblique circular cylinder: Cavalieri, V = base area * vertical height = pi 25 * 20 = 1570.8. Area = two discs 2 pi 25 + lateral = perimeter of the right section (ellipse a 5, b 5 cos45) * slant 20 sqrt2 = 921.119 total; bbox x -5..25, y +-5, z 0..20; faces: oblique cylinder and two discs.
